page.overview:
What is Firs Island?

Firs Island was one of the Endpoints and a Marine base in the New World.

Firs Island has a large volcano on the island, and underneath it houses a heavily armed Marine base, containing a large bridge linking to the inside. Inside the heavy duty security chamber is where the Marines stored the Dyna Stones.

As one of the three Endpoints, Firs Island acts as a seal to the vast quantities of subterranean magma underneath the New World. Should sufficient damage be inflicted onto this Endpoint, it will cause the volcano to erupt in a very devastating burst.

Following Shuzo's defeat at the hands of Luffy and his imprisonment in Impel Down, the Neo Marines arrived at Firs Island.
